reviews.title: I really wanted to like this app
reviews.text:
This app is stupid. I was so excited for the first week or using this app. However - once you log out or delete the app and try to go back into your account, it just doesn’t work. 
The progress tracking was great and the community stuff with other people was cool. But the Permanent lock down isn’t permanent at all. If you decide you want to unlock an app or remove one, you just want 1 hour and it lets you get full access again….which kind of defeats the whole purpose when it comes down to the heat of the moment and fighting those urges. 
Another terrible issue I’ve come in contact with this logging back in. I PAID for a year subscription and was happy for about a week. And then I noticed none of the community group pages or chats were updating. So I thought, “hey maybe I need to restart the app or try logging out/logging back in.” And therein lies the problem: you’re screwed after that. Upon trying to log back in, you get 3 options:
1) Start from scratch
2) Login using Apple
3) Login using Google

NEITHER of the 2 Login options actually work. It just spins and spins and spins or looks like it’s accepted your log in credentials and then does nothing. Until I can get logged back in to my original account and see my progress/use the subscription I paid for, there’s no point in me using this as the data isnt accurate anymore.

reviews.title: App broken
reviews.text:
Had the app for over a year and it is indeed a helpful app. There are so many useful tools to help when you’re tempted plus a community tab where you can see posts others make so you’re not alone.

I paid for a year $30 and then attempted to upgrade to the lifetime subscription which was another $30, fine. But it would not let me upgrade at all until my subscription expired, the upgrade button did nothing until then.

My reason for the 2 stars is I contacted support 2 times for the upgrade button and heard nothing back (3 weeks ago) and contacted them again this week because the community tab has crashed for everyone. App still works but you can’t post or see anything new since 4 days ago till the day of this review. App is fantastic but with the amount of subscribers/money the devs need to get their stuff together.

reviews.title: I Want It To Work
reviews.text:
There are a lot of good things in this app. It advertises itself to help you keep track of your urges, let you write a journal, and have an entire community to talk to to back you up.

However, the app has its bugs and I don’t see them getting fixed anytime soon. The journal will glitch out every so often and mess up your typing, the AI bot they have isn’t functional at all, and the coping strategies to deal with urges are shockingly shallow. All it tells you to do is breathe in and out no matter what your circumstances are; alone or in public, at home or at work—it doesn’t matter. Just breathe in and out and it’ll allll be good, right?

But the app does feel like it’s got some footing. I just wish it was worth the money I put into it.

reviews.title: Do not download
reviews.text:
To be clear this company had a data breach for 600,000 users, and the company’s response was to first deny, then they took months to fix the problem. To make matters worse, even though they fixed the breach, they still don’t have the level of encryption their competitors offer. Imagine having all of your private logs and most personal information in your recovery journey become publicly readable. 

I just wanted a refund from my subscription as it was less than 24 hours from when I got it. I didn’t want to leave any negative review.  At the end of the day this company will take every dollar it can from people. Just look at all the reviews of people who were scammed into thinking they got a lifetime subscription. I get as a company wanting to make a profit, but there’s no need to be sloppy with policy and reckless with data security. Thankfully there are other secure alternatives that genuinely help and care about security. Hope I have prevented at least one person from making the same mistake as I have.
